name: pagelingo
description: Shared translation SDK and applications for technical reading.

scripts.dev:extension: npm run build:sdk && npm run dev --workspace @pagelingo/extension
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build --workspace @pagelingo/translation-core && npm run build --workspace @pagelingo/assistant-core
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --workspace @pagelingo/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:bundle && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:bundle && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:sdk: npm run build:sdk && npm run test --workspace @pagelingo/translation-core
scripts.test:extension: npm run build:sdk && npm run test --workspace @pagelingo/extension
scripts.test:watch: npm run build:sdk && npm run test:watch --workspace @pagelingo/extension
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:sdk && npm run test:e2e --workspace @pagelingo/extension
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:glossary && npm run test:package && npm run test:e2e
scripts.pdf:lint: uv run --directory services/document-parser --locked --no-sync ruff check src tests
scripts.build:contracts: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --workspace @pagelingo/document-contracts
scripts.build:service: npm run build:bundle && npm run build --workspace @pagelingo/document-service
scripts.test:service: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspace @pagelingo/document-service
scripts.test:service:db: npm run build:contracts && node scripts/with-test-postgres.mjs -- npm run test:integration --workspace @pagelingo/document-service --
scripts.build:site: npm run build:service && npm run build --workspace @pagelingo/web
scripts.site:db: docker compose --project-name pagelingo-site-dev --env-file .env.site-dev.local -f deploy/compose.site.yml -f deploy/compose.site-dev.yml up -d --wait db
scripts.build:renderer: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @pagelingo/document-renderer
scripts.build:bundle: npm run build:renderer && npm run build --workspace @pagelingo/document-bundle
scripts.build:pdf: npm run build:bundle && npm run build --workspace @pagelingo/pdf-cli
scripts.pdf:process: npm run build:pdf && node apps/pdf-cli/dist/cli.js process
scripts.pdf:translate: npm run build:pdf && node apps/pdf-cli/dist/cli.js translate
scripts.pdf:bundle: npm run build:pdf && node apps/pdf-cli/dist/cli.js bundle
scripts.pdf:verify: npm run build:pdf && node apps/pdf-cli/dist/cli.js verify
scripts.test:pdf:offline: npm run build:pdf && node --import tsx apps/pdf-cli/tests/offline-browser.mjs
